description: This file provides Python source code implementing sandboxed filesystem operations such as directory traversal, file creation, reading, writing, and manipulation, intended for use within a larger project handling sandboxed environment mutations.

methods.name: open_dir
methods.description: Opens a directory with specific flags, handling optional directory flags based on os attributes.

methods.name: walk_parent
methods.description: Traverses a relative path from a given directory file descriptor, creating directories if enabled.

methods.name: create_temp_file
methods.description: Creates a temporary file within a parent directory, ensuring unique naming.

methods.name: fd_path
methods.description: Constructs a filesystem path for a file descriptor, optionally with a basename.

methods.name: run_command
methods.description: Executes a shell command with specified file descriptors passed through.

methods.name: write_stdin_to_fd
methods.description: Reads data from standard input and writes it to a specified file descriptor.

methods.name: run_write
methods.description: Performs writing operation: walks to a directory, creates a temp file, writes stdin, and replaces the target file.

methods.name: run_mkdirp
methods.description: Creates directories recursively by walking and invoking mkdir command.

methods.name: run_remove
methods.description: Removes a file or directory, optionally recursively and forcefully.

methods.name: run_rename
methods.description: Renames (moves) a file or directory from a source to a destination within sandboxed directories.
